name: Report tab to PDF
description: Prints a Report tab to a PDF file for each input record, from the tab's address in a field, saving the files in a folder.
introductoryText:
Prints Report tabs to PDF files: one file per input record, from the tab address (URL) in the chosen field. Use it after a **Project metadata** block, which lists each Report tab with its URL, or any records holding addresses such as `http://127.0.0.1:24679/Folder/Project.iox/r/Report/#Tab`.

**How to set it up**: choose the field with the Report tab URLs and an output folder. Optionally choose a field with the file names (without `.pdf`); otherwise files are named `<Report>-<Tab>-<n>.pdf`, where n counts the records from 0. Page width and height (pixels) override the Report's own page size.

The output has one record per PDF written: the URL, the file name and the full path. Records with an empty URL are skipped. Two records with the same file name get `-2`, `-3` added rather than overwriting each other.

**What it needs.** Chrome, driven by the `visokio-omniprint` Python package (installed on first run). On a server that runs custom blocks in Docker, the block uses its own image with Chrome included ([Docker setup](https://help.visokio.com/support/solutions/articles/42000071133-setting-up-the-custom-block)); otherwise Chrome must be installed on the machine running Omniscope. The Report must be reachable from that machine at the address given.

**Authentication.** If the Report or its folder needs a login that the server's own browser session doesn't have (for example Basic Authentication, with Local Desktop Experience turned off), enter a username and password. They are used only to open the page; they are not written to the output.

**If it fails**: replace the block with a fresh one from the block picker, update Chrome (or the Docker image), and raise the loading delay if pages come out half drawn.

options.name: report
options.title: Report tab URL field
options.description: The field holding each Report tab's address, such as http://127.0.0.1:24679/Folder/Project.iox/r/Report/#Tab (a Project metadata block gives these).

options.name: fileName
options.title: File name field
options.description: Optional. The field holding each PDF's file name, without .pdf. Empty: <Report>-<Tab>-<n>.pdf.

options.name: outputFolder
options.title: Output folder
options.description: The folder the PDF files are saved in, on the machine running Omniscope. Created if missing; files with the same name are replaced.

options.name: pageWidth
options.title: Page width (pixels)
options.description: Optional. Overrides the Report's page size (A4, or the Report's fixed size).

options.name: pageHeight
options.title: Page height (pixels)
options.description: Optional. Overrides the Report's page size (A4, or the Report's fixed size).

options.name: chromeDelay
options.title: Loading delay (seconds)
options.description: Extra seconds to wait after the Report has finished drawing, before printing. Raise it if charts come out half drawn.

options.name: auth_username
options.title: Username
options.description: Optional. For a Report behind Basic Authentication.

options.name: auth_password
options.title: Password
options.description: Optional. Used only to open the page; not written to the output.

blockOutputs.label: PDFs
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per PDF written: URL, PDF filename, PDF path.
